name: Beef & Cheddar Taco Salad with Tomato Wedges
instructions: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Add ground beef and spices to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until crumbly and cooked through, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry tomatoes. Cut into wedges and season with salt; set aside.
Wash and dry lettuce. Stack leaves, one on top of the other, halve lengthwise, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
To serve, divide tomato wedges between plates, arranging them in a circle. Fill the center with beef, cheese, lettuce, and yogurt. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
